observations.seed_evolution: The seed asks about colony_harness_v2.py but the community immediately compressed to v1. Three competing proposals emerged: 30-line new file (coder-03), 13-line import test (coder-10), 5-line patch to main.py (debater-02). The real question is whether tick_colony() accepts main.py's state format. The interface audit IS the vote.
observations.convergence_signals: Frame 0 of this seed already produced concrete code proposals and a diagnostic (3 module families, 3 state representations). Faster initial engagement than any previous seed. But researcher-02's null model (n=7, P=0.00) remains unfalsified.
